CAMPUS MINISTRY
INTERNSHIPS
Campus Crusade for Christ has a rich history of
students believing God for great things. College
students have been taking one year STINTs and
launching new campus ministries all over the world in
places such as Russia, East Asia, and the Middle East.
College students reaching college students–that’s the
history of Campus Crusade for Christ.
And why go alone? Bring your friends with you!
Ministry is much more effective when it’s done by
teams of people believing God and working together.
Look through history. Thousands have gone before us
to reach students. Now it’s our turn. It’s our turn to be
the new pioneers who build the foundations for the
next century.
And that history continues to be made. Right now
on campuses all over the world students are ready to
respond to the gospel. Yet, more laborers–students
and those fresh out of college–are needed. God is
calling people who desire to pioneer new ministries in
the United States and around the world.
WHAT IS A CAMPUS MINISTRY INTERNSHIP?
Whether you are stateside or overseas, you will spend
a year helping to fulfill the Great Commission. Use
your gifts, abilities, and even professional skills to
reach students for Christ.
That’s why the Campus Ministry of Campus Crusade
for Christ has developed this unique avenue of
ministry. You could be a Campus Ministry intern–a
one-year commitment to believe God to do something
powerful in and through your life. We’ve been sending
students for a one-year STINT overseas for years, and
now we’re ready to send students everywhere–both in
the United States and internationally.
As an Intern you will:
Receive training in the context of a team
Acquire skills to help you continue to minister in
the marketplace
Gain time to decide if God may be leading you to
full-time ministry
Make an eternal difference in the lives of
students
Perhaps you’re not sure what you’ll do with the rest
of your life. Perhaps you would like to give a year of
your lifeto reaching students, discipling leaders, and
establishing new student ministries. Or maybe you
can picture yourself using your skills in your field of
study for ministry. Maybe you would just like to spend
a year getting a feel for full-time ministry.
What can happen in a year? In just a year, you could
pioneer a new ministry on a campus overseas. In just
a year, you could open up new campus ministries in
the United States. In just a year, you could establish a
ministry to reach ethnic students on a campus.
Salary
Upon acceptance as a Campus Ministry intern, you
will have the opportunity and responsibility to raise
your own financial support* to cover your salary,
ministry expenses and medical coverage. Your actual
amount will be determined by the location of your
ministry assignment and the nature of your work in
that assignment. You will receive further training on
how to raise support for your ministry.
Note: A special funding opportunity exists for Impact
interns. For more information, contact the Ethnic

I N T E R N S H I P 2
Student Ministries national office at (407) 826-2581.
College Credit
Your internship may qualify you for college credit
through your university. Contact your university for
more information.
How many U.S. college students are on God’s heart?
All 17 million of them! You can be a part of what God
is doing on campuses in the United States by working
with a full-time Campus Ministry staff team. You can
help create new strategies, gain leadership experience,
hone your small group skills, and invest yourself in
something that will outlive you. Imagine the impact
one year will have on the rest of your life
Deadlines
The deadline for submitting your completed
application is March 1 st. The completed application
includes your application, biographical material, all
elaboration forms and questionnaires, all references,
your signature page, and application fee. Late
applications will be charged a $50 non-refundable
application fee. Absolutely no applications will be
received after April 1st.
INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITIES
Catalytic
Catalytic is the umbrella term for mobilizing a
growing coalition of staff members, interns, students,
churches, and volunteers to expand to new, unreached
campuses. Picture yourself as part of a Metro Team
in a major city like New York, Atlanta, San Francisco
or Chicago. Or imagine being part of a pioneering
team opening new campus ministries for a broader
geographic area like Virginia, Wisconsin or Oregon.
Students are open, and we need your help to bring the
gospel to every campus
Worldwide Student Network (WSN)
Imagine yourself sitting in a café in Florence,
walking the streets of Argentina, or perusing a city
market in the Middle East while getting to know
university students and talking with them about your
relationship with Christ. You have the opportunity to
take the life-changing message of Christ to students
around the world. You’ll be amazed at the similarities
you find as you engage in conversation about your
lives, and gripped by the spiritual need of the students
you meet.
Bridges International
The world has come to our door. Some 700,000 of the
world’s brightest students are studying and living
in the United States. How would you like to spend
a year helping build a movement on a campus or in
a metropolitan area that is reaching these strategic
international students with the gospel and mobilizing
them for the worldwide harvest?
Ethnic Student Ministries (ESM)
Working with ESM, you can help reach a large and
vital population of college students. You could be part
of the Impact movement to touch African-American
students with the gospel. You could reach Hispanic-
American college students through the Destino
movement. Or join a team reaching Asian-Americans
through the Epic movement. Come and be a part
of this growing movement of students, volunteers
and church leaders who are doing God’s work in
innovative ways, all to ensure that every student hears
the gospel.
More information on ESM internships can be found
at each movement’s web site:
Many of tomorrow’s world leaders are on U.S.
campuses today, often coming from nations that
are difficult for Americans to enter. As a Bridges
International intern, you will have the chance to
emphasize ministry with one or more of the following
people group networks: Chinese, Japanese, or “The
Ishmael Project”. God has brought the world’s future
leaders to us. We need to send them home with more
than an academic education. For more information
contact Scott Garrity at 734-347-2001 or Scott.
Garrity@uscm.org
The Impact Fellowship Program
The Epic Internship
The Destino Internship
Staffed Campuses
National Campus Office and Campus Ministry
Regional Offices
Use your skills in accounting, computer technology
and programming, graphic design, video, journalism,
marketing, communication, advertising and many
others to help reach students. For a vital worldwide
movement, it’s crucial to have qualified individuals
doing ministry in highly skilled positions. Consider
being an intern in a Campus Ministry regional office
or at the nerve center of Campus Crusade for Christ–
the international headquarters in Orlando, Florida.

In ten cities around the nation staff members focus on
the leadership and administrative needs to move our
mission forward. The regional office might be a great
place for you to serve if you have gifts or interest in
accounting, computer technology and programming,
graphic design, video, journalism, marketing,
communication, advertising or other business skills.
For more information on Campus Ministry
internships and instructions on how to apply, go to the
Campus Ministry Website.
